Hi Anna — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: we heard that Ava Solutions is evaluating an inference solution to lower per-call latency for your summarization pipeline and that security/compliance and on-prem connectivity are high priority.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep dive (demo + architecture Q&A + integration checklist). Two slots that work on our side (PST):
- Option A: Tues Dec 8, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed Dec 9, 13:00–14:00 PT

Can you confirm which slot you prefer and who will attend from your side (titles/roles)? Also let us know if you prefer Zoom or Google Meet — we can send the invite either way.

Prep we’ll bring: a short agenda, an initial mutual action plan (I’ll attach), and a list of items we’ll need if you want a hands-on integration: sample prompts, expected qps, and a short network whitelist checklist.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (stub)

If either slot doesn’t work, give me a couple of alternatives and we’ll sync.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our SE to join the deep dive once time is locked.

— Rishi
